title: weaponlab-partsmap/1
description: How a 3D model maps onto a gun's action: its file, units and axes, where the bolt face is, which objects or vertex groups make each moving part, and the marks a hand or a check needs. Marks, pivots and lips are in gun space (cm, +Y to the muzzle, +Z up, +X the gun's left, origin the bolt face); axes are unit vectors in gun space. Objects in no part are the body.

name.description: the gun's name in file and asset names

model.description: the model file: .blend, .fbx, .obj or .glb (null only for a proxy, built from its shapes)

forward.description: the model's axis toward the muzzle

origin.description: the bolt face, in the model's own units and axes

parts.description: role -> the objects or vertex groups that move as that part

mark_parts.description: mark -> the part it rides, or the chain of parts from the nearest outward

normals.description: mark -> the way its surface faces

proxy.description: a test model: every picture of it says so

blueprint.description: the blueprint this parts map was written from, when there is one

kind.description: how it moves, when the action allows more than one way (else the action's)

parent.description: the part this one rides (a cylinder on its crane)
